description: A Starlight docs site, deployed by every merge to main, so each Renovate PR is a deploy. Managers: npm (package.json and package-lock.json), the Node version in .nvmrc, and GitHub Actions. Lock-file refreshes stay off (the shared default): npm cannot hold a refresh to the 14-day wait.

packageRules.description: One weekly PR for the non-major npm updates, so a site gets at most one routine deploy a week from Renovate.
Node is pinned in .nvmrc and in the workflows' setup-node; they move in one PR.
